actionInbox: Quick actions (long press on the icon)
widgetOverview: The overview widget (FlowplanTasks): not "Aufgaben" – that is the suite's widget that checks off.
voiceFile: The file name stays ASCII, like the other languages' names.
updateAllowText: Android's own names in the settings: "Install unknown apps" (de: "Unbekannte Apps installieren", fr: "Installer des applis inconnues", zh: "安装未知应用") and its switch "Allow from this source" (de: "Aus dieser Quelle zulassen", fr: "Autoriser cette source", zh: "允许来自此来源的应用").
updateProgress: Progress of the update download in megabytes (fr: Mo).
